# @volcanicminds/admin: LLM guide

> Manifest-driven backoffice engine for the Volcanic Minds ecosystem (codename `phoenix`),
> built on Refine (headless data, auth and access-control layer) and shadcn/ui (Radix plus
> Tailwind). It renders a complete admin panel (list, create, edit, show, filters, global
> search, pagination, XLS import and export, login flow with MFA and step-up, multi-tenant,
> platform console) from a manifest that `@volcanicminds/backend` v5 emits at runtime.
>
> This file is the reference for an AI agent that consumes or extends the package. It describes
> version `0.5.0-alpha.0` (the `v5` line, published on the `next` dist-tag) talking to
> `@volcanicminds/backend` v5. When this file and the code disagree, the code in `src/` wins.
> The engine is domain-agnostic; the bundled `src/mock` "Acme Corp" sample is a development
> fixture, excluded from the published build and not part of the API.

## Index

1. What it is
2. Install, exports and peers
3. Backend prerequisites

21. Mock mode and the demo app
22. Typed field names and the pull CLI
23. Public API index
24. Gotchas

## 1. What it is

The backend describes (it compiles a manifest of its administrable routes); the admin builds
itself by reading that manifest. Nobody hand-draws the screens. The project then refines the
result with overrides (labels, ordering, widgets, theme). The backend emits only data and
structure: every human-facing label is an i18n key, and all presentation and ordering live in the
admin.

The repository is both the library and a demo app (`src/App.tsx` plus `src/mock`). Internal split:

```
src/
  engine/   headless, UI-agnostic; never imports ui/
    types/manifest.ts     manifest spec v2 (the contract)
    types/model.ts        interpreted model the UI consumes (AdminModel, ResourceModel)
    interpreter.ts        interpretManifest, toRefineResources
    merge.ts              mergeManifest, deepMerge, ManifestOverrides types
    magic-query.ts        buildMagicQuery, searchFilter, readTotal
    actions.ts            interpolatePath, matchVisibleWhen, actionsByTarget
    providers/            data, http, auth, accessControl, tenant, errors
    auth/                 client (login flow, renewal, account), endpoints, tokenStore, stepUp
    registry.tsx          override registry (widget, view, action)
    i18n.tsx              key resolution, defaultDictionaries
    manifest.tsx          ManifestProvider, useModel, useResourceModel
  ui/       shadcn implementation; consumes the engine and is replaceable
    components/           primitives, ConfirmDialog, StepUpDialog, UnsavedChangesGuard
    widgets/              inputs, display, ReferenceSelect, upload/, richtext/, tags/
    generators/           ListView (table, cards), AutoForm, ShowView, SingletonView, FilterBar, ListIO, routes
    actions/              ActionButtons, capability runner, TenantDestroy
    layout/               AdminLayout, Sidebar, TenantSwitcher, icons
    views/                LoginView, ForgotPasswordView, ResetPasswordView, AccountView
  mock/     in-memory backend (Acme Corp sample), dev only
  VolcanicAdmin.tsx       the public root component
  index.ts                library entry: engine plus ui plus <VolcanicAdmin>
```

The library build (`vite.config.lib.ts`) excludes `src/mock/**`, `src/App.tsx`, `src/main.tsx`
and `src/vite-env.d.ts`.

---

## 2. Install, exports and peers

```bash
npm i @volcanicminds/admin@next \
  react react-dom react-router \
  @refinedev/core @refinedev/react-router @refinedev/react-hook-form react-hook-form
```

`next` is the line for backend 5. The `latest` dist-tag (0.4.x) is the line for backend 4 and
uses login routes that backend 5 no longer has.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Module format | ESM only (`"type": "module"`), Node >= 26 for tooling |
| Export `.` | `dist/index.js` plus `dist/index.d.ts`: engine, ui and `<VolcanicAdmin>` |
| Export `./styles.css` | `dist/style.css`, the prebuilt theme; import it once, no Tailwind needed |
| Export `./tailwind-preset` | `tailwind-preset.js`, for projects that write their own Tailwind components |
| Bin | `volcanic-admin-pull` (`scripts/pull-manifest.mjs`), see section 22 |
| Shipped files | `dist`, `tailwind-preset.js`, `scripts`, `manifest.v2.schema.json`, `README.md` |

Peer dependencies (the app provides one copy of each): `react` ^18.3.1, `react-dom` ^18.3.1,
`react-router` ^7.1.1, `@refinedev/core` ^4.57.0, `@refinedev/react-router` ^1.0.1,
`@refinedev/react-hook-form` ^4.10.0, `react-hook-form` ^7.54.2. Bundled dependencies include
Radix primitives, TipTap (rich text, lazy-loaded), `xlsx` (lazy-loaded), `sonner`, `lucide-react`
and `ajv`.

A project that writes its own Tailwind components applies the preset:

```js
// tailwind.config.js
import volcanicPreset from '@volcanicminds/admin/tailwind-preset'
export default { presets: [volcanicPreset], content: ['./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'] }
```

---

## 3. Backend prerequisites

On the `@volcanicminds/backend` v5 side:

- The manifest is opt-in: set `config.options.manifest.enabled = true`. Then `GET /admin/manifest`
  serves the tenant plane; `GET /system/manifest` serves the control plane and exists only when
  the deployment declares tenants.
- Both routes need an authenticated session and the `manifest` capability. Grant it to the roles
  that operate the console. Within a plane the manifest is the same for every caller: it carries
  each capability's declared roles, the console hides what the caller cannot reach, and every
  route still enforces its own gate.
- Resource routes are mounted at the API root (`/brands`, `/tenants/:id`); `/admin` holds the
  manifest only.
- The backend default `AUTH_MODE` is `COOKIE` (needs the `cookie` plugin); `BEARER` is the
  alternative. In cookie mode the API must allow credentialed CORS from the console origin.
- List responses carry `v-total`, `v-count` and `v-pageSize`; the backend exposes them through CORS.

---

## 4. Minimal app

```tsx
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import { VolcanicAdmin } from '@volcanicminds/admin'
import type { Dictionaries } from '@volcanicminds/admin'
import '@volcanicminds/admin/styles.css'

const dictionaries: Dictionaries = {
  en: { 'res.brand.plural': 'Brands', 'field.brand.name': 'Name' }
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <VolcanicAdmin
    apiUrl={import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL} // the backend that serves /admin/manifest
    dictionaries={dictionaries}
  />
)
```

With no `authMode` the console starts in cookie mode and switches to bearer by itself when the
login answers with a token (section 6). A platform console for operators is the same component
with `plane="control"`. A console that serves a single customer of a multi-tenant backend passes
`tenant="acme"`.

Pinned manifest with typed overrides (see section 22):

```tsx
import { VolcanicAdmin } from '@volcanicminds/admin'
import { generatedManifest } from './manifest.generated'
import { overrides } from './manifest.overrides'

export const App = () => (
  <VolcanicAdmin apiUrl="https://api.example.com" manifest={generatedManifest} manifestOverrides={overrides} />
)
```

---

## 5. `<VolcanicAdmin>` props

Source: `src/VolcanicAdmin.tsx` (`VolcanicAdminProps`). Every prop is optional.

| Prop | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `apiUrl` | `string` | Backend base URL. Fallback `http://0.0.0.0:2230`. |
| `authMode` | `'cookie' \| 'bearer'` | Token transport. Default: `manifest.auth.mode`; before a manifest exists, `'cookie'` or the mode detected at login. |
| `plane` | `'tenant' \| 'control'` | Default `'tenant'`. `'control'` is the platform console: `/system/auth/*`, `/system/manifest`, no tenant header, no self-service password routes. |
| `tenant` | `string` | Tenant of a single-customer console, sent in the tenant header from the login on and never asked. Ignored on the control plane. |
| `tenantHeader` | `string` | Tenant header before a manifest names it. Default `'x-tenant-id'`. |
| `basename` | `string` | Router basename when the admin is mounted under a sub-path. |
| `manifest` | `Manifest` | Static manifest; skips fetching. |
| `loadManifest` | `() => Promise<Manifest>` | Custom loader. Default: `GET ${apiUrl}/admin/manifest` (`/system/manifest` on the control plane) with the session. |
| `apiBasePath` | `string` | Prefix between `apiUrl` and every resource path. Default `''`. Set it only when a proxy publishes the API under a sub-path that `apiUrl` does not include. |
| `authEndpoints` | `Partial<Record<string, string>>` | Auth routes that win over `manifest.auth.endpoints`, key by key (`flowStart`, `flowStep`, `refresh`, `logout`, `me`, and so on). Unset keys follow the manifest, then the plane defaults. |
| `manifestOverrides` | `ManifestOverrides<any>` | Project overrides merged onto the manifest by resource and field name (section 11). |
| `dataProvider` | `DataProvider` (Refine) | Replaces the Volcanic data provider (a mock, for instance). |
| `authClient` | `AuthClient` | Replaces the Volcanic auth client (section 8). |
| `dictionaries` | `Dictionaries` | i18n maps keyed by locale, then by key. Merged over `defaultDictionaries`. |
| `defaultLocale` | `string` | Default from `manifest.i18n.defaultLocale`. |
| `locales` | `string[]` | Default from `manifest.i18n.locales`. |
| `overrides` | `AdminOverrides` = `{ widget?, view?, action? }` | Components keyed by registry id, each a `Record<string, ComponentType<any>>` (section 12, section 16). |
| `theme` | `AdminTheme` | Theme tokens injected as CSS variables, with a `dark` sub-block (section 20). |
| `branding` | `AdminBranding` | App name and logos for sidebar and login (section 20). |
| `plugins` | `AdminPlugin[]` | Bundles of `widgets`, `views`, `actions`, `routes`, `dictionaries`, `theme`, `branding` (plus an optional `name`). Direct props win on key collisions. `defineAdminPlugin()` is the typed identity helper. |
| `fetchTenants` | `() => Promise<TenantOption[]>` | Tenant list for a switcher, read only when the manifest declares `tenancy.switchable`. No default: a v5 backend binds the tenant to the token and emits `switchable: false`. |
| `routes` | `AdminCustomRoute[]` | Extra screens: `{ path, element, index?, nav? }`. `index: true` makes it the home route; `nav` (an `AdminNavItem` without `path`: `label`, `icon?`, `group?`, `order?`) adds a sidebar entry. |
| `loading` | `ReactNode` | Rendered while the manifest loads. |
| `toastPosition` | `'top-left' \| 'top-center' \| 'top-right' \| 'bottom-left' \| 'bottom-center' \| 'bottom-right'` | Default `'bottom-right'`. |

Plugin composition order: plugins in array order, then direct props. Dictionaries merge per
locale over `defaultDictionaries`; theme tokens and `dark` merge shallowly; branding merges
shallowly; widget, view and action maps merge by id.

```tsx
import { defineAdminPlugin } from '@volcanicminds/admin'

export const themePlugin = defineAdminPlugin({
  name: 'theme',
  theme: { primary: '221 83% 53%', radius: '0.75rem', dark: { primary: '217 91% 60%' } },
  branding: { appName: 'Acme Admin', logo: '/logo.svg', logoDark: '/logo-dark.svg' }
})
```

---

## 6. Boot sequence

1. The router, `ThemeProvider` and theme CSS mount; the tenant store is primed from `tenant`, the
   tenant remembered in this browser (`localStorage` key `volcanic.admin.tenant`) or nothing.
2. The manifest source is chosen: `manifest` prop (no fetch), else `loadManifest`, else the
   default fetch. The default fetch authenticates exactly as a data request does: tenant header,
   bearer token or cookies, and one renewal on a 401.
3. If the load fails with 401, `TENANT_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_NOT_FOUND` or `SCOPE_MISMATCH`, a
   bootstrap login is drawn instead of an error (with the forgot and reset password screens on
   the tenant plane). A completed login loads the manifest again. Any other failure shows
   "Manifest error" with the status and backend `code`.
4. Before a manifest, the mode is a guess. If the login answers with a token while the console
   assumed cookie, the console switches to bearer for the requests that follow. A token found in
   the store at boot is also read as evidence of a bearer deployment, so a reload keeps the session.
5. The manifest is merged with the overrides and interpreted. On the control plane the engine
   first applies its own built-in overrides (the `tenant` resource's `data` capability uses the
   `tenant-destroy` component; `systemUser.roles` is read as an `enum`), then the project's on top.
6. If `manifest.auth.plane` is present and differs from the `plane` prop, the console refuses to
   render and says so: every call of the other plane would be refused.
7. The runtime mounts Refine with `syncWithLocation`, `mutationMode: 'optimistic'`,
   `disableTelemetry`, and `warnWhenUnsavedChanges: false` (unsaved changes are handled by the
   form's own `UnsavedChangesGuard` modal). Routes: `/login`, `/forgot-password`,
   `/reset-password`, `/account`, the custom routes, and per resource `<path>`, `<path>/create`
   (with `create`), `<path>/edit/:id` (with `update`), `<path>/show/:id`; a singleton gets only
   `<path>`. Unauthenticated users are redirected to `/login`.

---

## 7. Planes and tenancy

A console works on one plane:

| | `plane="tenant"` (default) | `plane="control"` |
|---|---|---|
| Who | a customer's users | the platform's operators |
| Manifest | `/admin/manifest` | `/system/manifest` |
| Login flow | `/auth/flow/*` | `/system/auth/flow/*` |
| Identity | `GET /users/me` | `GET /system/auth/me` |
| Tenant header | per `manifest.tenancy` | never |
| Forgot and reset password | yes | no (operators are provisioned) |
| MFA disable on the account page | yes | no |

`manifest.tenancy` as a v5 backend emits it: `{ mode: 'single' }` without tenants;
`{ mode: 'multi', switchable: false, header: 'x-tenant-id' }` on the tenant plane with the header
resolver (the header name follows the backend `headerKey`); `{ mode: 'multi', switchable: false }`
with the subdomain resolver and on the control plane. `listEndpoint` is no longer emitted.

Runtime rules (`src/engine/providers/tenant.tsx`):

- The tenant header is sent only when `mode` is `multi` and a `header` is named (or a switcher is
  active). No header in single mode, under the subdomain resolver or on the control plane.
- The tenant comes from the `tenant` prop (fixed, never asked) or from the login screen, which
  asks for an organization when the console is multi-tenant, names a header, has no fixed tenant
  and no switcher. The typed value is remembered in `localStorage`.
- On a v5 backend the token binds the tenant from the login on (claim `tid`); a different tenant
  under the same session is refused with 403 `TENANT_MISMATCH`. A different tenant is a new login.
- The header rides every request: data, manifest, auth flow and renewal (the renewal needs it to
  find the container the refresh token belongs to). `tenantStore.headers()` returns it.
- A switcher (`TenantSwitcher`) appears only with `tenancy.switchable: true` and `fetchTenants`;
  a v5 backend never declares it.

---

## 8. Authentication

Source: `src/engine/auth/client.ts`, `endpoints.ts`, `tokenStore.ts`, `stepUp.ts`,
`src/engine/providers/auth.ts`, `src/ui/views/LoginView.tsx`. Backend spec: `docs/AUTH_FLOW_V5.md`
in `volcanic-backend`.

### Endpoints

There is no login route and no second-factor route: a login is a flow. Plane defaults
(`PLANE_ENDPOINTS`), overridden by `manifest.auth.endpoints`, then by the `authEndpoints` prop:

| Key | Tenant plane | Control plane |
|---|---|---|
| `flowOptions` | `GET /auth/flow/options` | `GET /system/auth/flow/options` |
| `flowStart` | `/auth/flow/start` | `/system/auth/flow/start` |
| `flowStep` | `/auth/flow/step` | `/system/auth/flow/step` |
| `flowChallenge` | `/auth/flow/challenge` | `/system/auth/flow/challenge` |
| `flowCancel` | `/auth/flow/cancel` | `/system/auth/flow/cancel` |
| `flowStepUp` | `/auth/flow/step-up` | `/system/auth/flow/step-up` |
| `refresh` | `/auth/refresh-token` | `/system/auth/refresh-token` |
| `logout` | `/auth/logout` | `/system/auth/logout` |
| `me` | `GET /users/me` | `GET /system/auth/me` |
| `sessions` | `/auth/sessions` (from the manifest) | `/system/auth/sessions` |
| `mfaSetup`, `mfaEnable` | `/auth/mfa/setup`, `/auth/mfa/enable` | `/system/auth/mfa/setup`, `/system/auth/mfa/enable` |
| `mfaDisable` | `/auth/mfa/disable` | absent |
| `changePassword`, `forgotPassword`, `resetPassword` | `/auth/change-password`, `/auth/forgot-password`, `/auth/reset-password` | absent |

Flow calls are POST unless marked GET. A key absent on a plane is refused by the client with
`code: 'ENDPOINT_NOT_AVAILABLE'` instead of being sent.

### The flow

1. `GET .../flow/options` lists the identifiers of the plane (`FlowOptions.options`, plus
   `accountCreation` on the tenant plane). The login screen draws `password` (email plus
   password), `email-otp` (a code sent to the address) and one button per provider of `oidc`.
   Methods and providers are codes; the console draws its own labels.
2. `flowStart(method, input)` posts `{ method, ...input }` (for instance
   `{ method: 'password', email, password }`).
3. A 200 is the session (`AuthData`: `token`, `refreshToken` in bearer mode). A 202 is a partial
   authentication: `{ flow, expiresAt, stage: { options: FlowOption[] } }`, the stage owed next.
4. Each stage is answered with `flowStep(method, input)`; `flowStep(method, {}, 'enrol')` starts
   an enrolment. The login screen draws the `totp` and `email-otp` stages (with resend through
   `flowChallenge` and its countdown from `challenge.resendAt`) and a forced TOTP enrolment
   (`enrol` carries the `MfaSetup`: `qrCode`, `uri`, `secret`). Any other stage method ends in a
   "not supported" message.
5. A `FlowOption.action` of type `redirect` or `post` sends the browser to an external provider.
   The console records the method in `sessionStorage` before leaving and, when the provider
   brings the browser back, resumes the flow with a step.
6. `flowCancel()` ends the flow in progress and never fails.

The flow credential (`vf1.`) never travels in `Authorization`. In bearer mode it is held in
`sessionStorage` (`volcanic.admin.flow`) and sent as the body field `flow`; in cookie mode the
backend keeps it in an HttpOnly cookie. Flow requests are sent without the stored bearer token
(a stale or other-plane token would be refused with `SCOPE_MISMATCH`).

### Refusals and remaining attempts

A refused call throws an `Error` carrying `status`, `code` (the backend machine code, always
present even when `HIDE_ERROR_DETAILS` strips the message), `remaining` (attempts left after a
wrong code) and `retryAt` (when a refused send may be asked again). The login screen appends
"N attempts left" (`login.error.remaining`, `{remaining}`) when `remaining > 0`.

`FLOW_ENDING_CODES` (exported) end the flow and send the screen back to its first step:
`AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `AUTH_INPUT_INVALID`, `FLOW_REQUIRED`, `FLOW_EXPIRED`,
`FLOW_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED`, `FLOW_ENROLMENT_REFUSED`, `IDP_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER`, `IDP_UNAVAILABLE`,
`IDP_RETURN_INVALID`, `IDP_DENIED`, `IDP_IDENTITY_NOT_LINKED`, `ACCOUNT_PENDING_APPROVAL`.
A failed login is always `401 AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`; `PASSWORD_TO_BE_CHANGED` is shown as an
expired password. Other mapped codes: `TENANT_NOT_FOUND`, `FLOW_CODE_INVALID`,
`FLOW_CODE_EXPIRED`, `FLOW_SEND_LIMIT`, `FLOW_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`.

### Cookie and bearer

| | Cookie (backend default) | Bearer |
|---|---|---|
| Access and refresh token | HttpOnly cookies set by the backend | `localStorage` keys `volcanic.admin.token`, `volcanic.admin.refresh` |
| Requests | `credentials: 'include'` | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` |
| Renewal | `POST refresh` with an empty body | `POST refresh` with `{ token, refreshToken }` |
| Flow credential | HttpOnly cookie | body field `flow`, held in `sessionStorage` |

Renewal: on a 401 the data provider, the manifest loader and the account calls renew once and
send the request again; concurrent callers share one renewal. A 401 that is a flow refusal is
not renewed.

### Step-up

A route that wants a fresh proof answers 403 `STEP_UP_REQUIRED` (with an optional `maxAge` in
seconds). The data provider and the auth client then call the step-up broker
(`createStepUpBroker`); `StepUpDialog` asks for a password or emailed code for the session's own
address, then its second factor, through `flowStepUp` and `flowStep`. On success the request is
sent once more. In bearer mode the new access token is stored by `adoptStepUp`; the refresh
token does not change. Concurrent refusals share one dialog. A method the dialog cannot draw ends
in "sign in again".

### Account page

`/account` (`AccountView`) shows the identity and roles, changes the password (tenant plane),
enables MFA (QR plus TOTP) or disables it (tenant plane), and lists the caller's sessions from
`auth.endpoints.sessions` with a button to close one (`DELETE <sessions>/<sid>`). When the answer
is not a list (a build without a session registry), the section hides.

### Custom auth client

`authClient` replaces the real client. It must implement `AuthClient`: `flowOptions`,
`flowStart`, `flowStep`, `flowChallenge`, `flowCancel`, `stepUp`, `setupMfa`, `enableMfa`,
`disableMfa`, `changePassword`, `forgotPassword`, `resetPassword`, `me`, `logout`, and optionally
`renew`. Refine's `getPermissions` reads the roles from `me().roles`.

---

## 9. The manifest v2 contract

Source of truth: `src/engine/types/manifest.ts` and `manifest.v2.schema.json` (Ajv schema used by
the pull CLI and the test suite). The interpreter warns on `version !== 2`.

### Top level (`Manifest`)

```ts
interface Manifest {
  version: 2
  generatedAt: string
  i18n: { defaultLocale: string; locales: string[] }
  auth: {
    mode: 'cookie' | 'bearer'
    plane?: 'tenant' | 'control'
    endpoints: { flowOptions: string; flowStart: string; flowStep: string; refresh: string; logout: string; [key: string]: string }
  }
  tenancy: { mode: 'single' | 'multi'; switchable?: boolean; header?: string; listEndpoint?: string }
  groups: GroupSpec[]                  // { name, label: I18nKey, icon?, order? }
  enums: Record<string, EnumOption[]>  // shared enums, referenced by FieldSpec.enumRef
  resources: ResourceSpec[]
  capabilities?: CapabilitySpec[]      // standalone operations not bound to a resource
}
```

`EnumOption`: `{ value: string; label: I18nKey; color?: string; group?: I18nKey; linkedGroup?: I18nKey }`.
`color` is a badge hint (section 20). `group` places the option in a section for widgets with a
grouped option set (the `tags` widget); the value is the section's i18n key, presentation only.
`linkedGroup` names a `group` of another field's option set so a widget can surface it first; it
never filters what the user can reach.

### `ResourceSpec`

| Property | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Canonical identity, the merge key. |
| `path` | `string` | Path segment relative to the API root, without a leading slash (`'brands'`). Also the admin route. |
| `label` | `{ singular: I18nKey; plural: I18nKey }` | `res.<name>.singular`, `res.<name>.plural`. |
| `icon`, `group`, `order` | `string`, `string`, `number` | Sidebar placement. |
| `idField` | `string` | |
| `titleField`, `subtitleField` | `string \| string[]` | Arrays are joined with spaces. |
| `documentTitle` | `string \| string[]` | Fields for the browser tab title on show and edit, prefixed by the singular label; falls back to `titleField`. |
| `tenantScoped`, `softDelete` | `boolean` | |
| `singleton` | `boolean` | One record at `path`: only an edit screen. |
| `capabilities` | `CapabilitySpec[]` | CRUD verbs and custom actions. |
| `defaultSort` | `{ field: string; order: 'asc' \| 'desc' }[]` | |
| `search` | `{ fields: string[]; operator?: FilterOperator }` | Presence enables the global search box. |
| `clonable` | `boolean` | Default true where `create` exists. |
| `cloneReset` | `Record<string, unknown>` | Values forced on a clone (form field names; the foreign key for relations). |
| `list`, `form` | `ListViewSpec`, `FormViewSpec` | Ordered view blocks, populated from overrides (section 11). |
| `fields` | `FieldSpec[]` | |
| `views` | `{ list?, create?, edit?, show? }` | `'auto'` or a registry `view` id that replaces the whole screen. |

### `CapabilitySpec`

`name` (unique in scope), `kind: 'list' | 'read' | 'create' | 'update' | 'delete' | 'action'`,
`method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'`, `path` (absolute from the API root, with
`:param` segments filled from the record), `roles: string[]`, `enabled?: boolean`.
Action-only: `label?`, `icon?`, `target?: ('row' | 'bulk' | 'collection')[]` (default row),
`payload?` (static body merge), `confirm?`, `confirmText?`, `visibleWhen?`
(`{ field: { operator: value } }`), `refresh?`, `download?` (mime), `component?: string | null`
(registry `action` id; null or absent means the generic handler), `input?: ActionInput`.

`ActionInput`: `{ fields: ActionInputField[]; submitLabel?: I18nKey }`;
`ActionInputField`: `{ name, label?, type?: FieldType, widget?, required?, placeholder? }`.

### `FieldSpec`

| Property | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name`, `type` | `string`, `FieldType` | |
| `label`, `help` | `I18nKey` | Default label key `field.<resource>.<field>`. |
| `required`, `readOnly`, `writeOnly`, `nullable` | `boolean` | `readOnly` fields render disabled and are not submitted; `writeOnly` (a password) is never read or listed and is excluded from columns and XLS. |
| `default` | `unknown` | Form seed. |
| `enum`, `enumRef` | `EnumOption[]`, `string` | Inline options or a reference into `Manifest.enums`. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | The value holds several enum values (Postgres `text[]`): one badge per value, filtered with `arrayOverlaps`. Pair with the `multiselect` or `tags` widget. |
| `relation` | `RelationSpec` | `{ resource, kind?: 'many-to-one' \| 'one-to-many' \| 'many-to-many', titleField?, foreignKey?, inverse? }`. The relation object is output-only; the form binds to `foreignKey`. |
| `image` | `ImageSpec` | See below. |
| `validation` | `ValidationSpec` | `{ required?, min?, max?, minLength?, maxLength?, pattern?, step? }`. |
| `filterable`, `sortable` | `boolean` | `filterable` opts into the filter dialog; `sortable` defaults to true. |
| `operators` | `FilterOperator[]` | Declared in the type; not read by the current UI. |

`FieldType`: `string`, `text`, `textarea`, `richtext`, `integer`, `number`, `boolean`, `date`,
`datetime`, `enum`, `relation`, `email`, `url`, `uuid`, `json`, `image`, `file`. The backend
infers only `string`, `integer`, `number`, `boolean`, `date`, `datetime`, `enum`, `email`, `url`,
`uuid`, `json`; the others come from overrides.

`FilterOperator` (type): `eq`, `neq`, `contains`, `containsi`, `ncontains`, `ncontainsi`,
`starts`, `startsi`, `ends`, `endsi`, `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le`, `between`, `in`, `nin`, `null`,
`notNull`, `overlap`, `arrayContains`. `raw` is never exposed.

`ImageSpec`: `multiple?`, `ordered?`, `fit?: 'cover' | 'contain'` (contain for logos),
`cover?: 'first' | 'flag'`, `altField?` (default `'altView'`), `accept?: string[]`, `maxSize?`
(bytes, checked after resize), `resize?: ImageResizeSpec`, `storage?: 'folder' | 's3' | string`,
`endpoints?: { upload?, reorder?, update?, remove? }`, each `{ method, path }`.

`ImageResizeSpec` (client-side downscale before upload, a convenience and not an enforcement):
`enabled?`, `format?: 'webp' | 'jpg' | 'png'` (default webp), `width?`, `height?`, `quality?`
(0 to 1, default 0.95), `reSample?` (0 to 4, default 2), `sharpen?`, `bgColor?`, `upscale?`
(default false), `keepIfLarger?` (default true), `skipUnder?` (bytes).

The engine interprets the manifest (`interpretManifest`) into an `AdminModel` of `ResourceModel`s
(`src/engine/types/model.ts`): enums resolved, columns, card slots, form sections, sort and filter
fields precomputed, `hasAction(verb)`, `roles(verb)` and `actions` derived from the capabilities
(an `enabled: false` capability does not count). `toRefineResources()` builds Refine's resource
list, sorted by group order then resource order.

---

## 10. How the backend generates the manifest

`lib/manifest/generator.ts` in `volcanic-backend` builds it from the registered routes and their
JSON schemas:

- Routes are grouped into resources by their first path segment (or a declared `prefix`).
  CRUD verbs are recognized from method plus relative path; other routes become `kind: 'action'`
  capabilities. Routes not bound to a resource become top-level `capabilities`.
- Fields come from the body (writable) and response (readable) schemas collapsed on
  (resource, field). Sensitive fields are marked `writeOnly` or dropped.
- Route-level hints, authored under `config.manifest` in the backend `routes.ts`:
  `group`, `resource: { name?, prefix?, titleField?, subtitleField?, globalSearch? }` (where
  `globalSearch` becomes `search: { fields, operator: 'containsi' }`), and `input` for an action body.
- Labels are keys: `res.<name>.singular|plural`, `group.<name>`.
- `auth.plane`, `auth.endpoints` and `tenancy` are set per plane (sections 7 and 8).
- A backend can also dump the manifest to a file (`MANIFEST_DUMP`, plane chosen by
  `MANIFEST_DUMP_PLANE`), which the pull CLI reads with `--from`.

---

## 11. The overrides model

Source: `src/engine/merge.ts`. The project keeps a hand-edited overrides object merged onto the
generated manifest by canonical identity (resources and fields by `name`), so it survives
regeneration. `mergeManifest(generated, overrides)` runs inside `ManifestProvider`.

```ts
interface ManifestOverrides<FM extends FieldMap = FieldMap> {
  i18n?: Partial<Manifest['i18n']>
  auth?: Partial<Manifest['auth']>
  tenancy?: Partial<Manifest['tenancy']>
  enums?: Record<string, EnumOption[]>
  groups?: GroupSpec[]                    // merge by name, new ones appended
  cardDefaults?: { cardColumns?: number; cardMinWidth?: number; cardMaxWidth?: number }
  resources?: { [R in keyof FM]?: ResourceOverride<Extract<FM[R], string>> }
  addResources?: ResourceSpec[]
  excludeResources?: Array<Extract<keyof FM, string>>
}
type FieldMap = Record<string, string>     // resource name to field-name union
```

`ResourceOverride<F>` accepts every `ResourceSpec` property except `name`, `fields` and
`capabilities` as a patch, plus:

| Key | Type | Semantics |
|---|---|---|
| `titleField`, `subtitleField`, `documentTitle` | `F \| F[]` | Typed against the field union. |
| `fields` | `Partial<Record<F, FieldOverride>>` | Deep-merge by field name. |
| `addFields` | `FieldSpec[]` | Appended. |
| `excludeFields` | `F[]` | Removed. |
| `capabilities` | `Record<string, CapabilityOverride>` | Deep-merge by capability name; unknown names are added. |
| `excludeCapabilities` | `string[]` | Removed, even when also patched. |
| `list` | `ListViewSpec<F>` | Collection view. |
| `form` | `FormViewSpec<F>` | Form and show view. |

`FieldOverride` is `Partial<FieldSpec>` without `name`, with `relation` and `image` as `Partial`
and `validation` as a full `ValidationSpec`. `CapabilityOverride` is `Partial<CapabilitySpec>`.

Merge semantics (`deepMerge`): plain objects merge recursively; arrays and scalars are replaced;
only `undefined` means "not overridden" (`0`, `false`, `''` and `null` all win). The `list` and
`form` blocks deep-merge their scalars and replace their arrays wholesale.

### Ordered view blocks

Array order is render order. A present array is the authoritative allowlist: a field not listed
does not appear in that view. An absent block is derived from the fields: table columns skip
`text`, `richtext`, `json`, `image`, `file` and `writeOnly` fields; sort options are the
sortable fields except `json`, `image`, `file`.

`ListViewSpec<F>`:
- `layouts?: ('table' | 'card')[]` (default `['table']`; more than one shows a toggle).
- `defaultLayout?` (default the first of `layouts`).
- `sort?: F[]`: fields of the "sort by" control; a relation tie-breaks by the row title.
- `table?: { columns?: ColumnSpec<F>[] }`, `ColumnSpec = { field, label?, align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right', width?: number }`.
- `card?: CardViewSpec<F>`: grid `minWidth`/`maxWidth` (setting `maxWidth` enables fluid
  auto-fill) or fixed `columns`; `align?: 'left' | 'center'`; slots `image?: F`,
  `title?: F | F[]`, `subtitle?: F | F[]`, `badges?: F[]` (enum chips), `body?: { field, label? }[]`,
  `highlight?: F` (boolean field shown as a featured ring and star). Omitted slots default to the
  first image field, `titleField` and `subtitleField`.

`FormViewSpec<F>` (create, edit and show):
- `columns?: number` (clamped 1 to 4, default 2). Image, richtext and `colSpan > 1` fields span
  the full row.
- `groups?: { name; label?; columns?; fields: FormFieldSpec<F>[] }[]`; the group header falls
  back to `group.<name>`.

`FormFieldSpec<F>`: `field: F`, `label?`, `widget?` (registry or built-in id, or `'auto'`),
`colSpan?`, `colStart?` (1-based grid column to start at; wraps if taken), `rowSpan?`,
`visibleOn?: 'create' | 'edit'`, `placeholder?`, `suggestions?: (string | number)[]` (for
`combobox`), `rows?` (visible text rows of `textarea` and `richtext`), `maxRows?` (richtext
height ceiling before internal scroll; defaults to `rows`, else 20, capped at 70vh),
`toolbar?: RichTextAction[]`, `featureFrom?: F`, `freeText?: 'off' | 'verbatim' | 'slug'`.

`RichTextAction`: `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `strike`, `h2`, `h3`, `bulletList`,
`orderedList`, `blockquote`, `link`, `clearFormat`, `undo`, `redo`. Unset means all; rendering
follows the widget's own order.

The interpreter overlays each `FormFieldSpec` onto a clone of the field as `field.form` (a
`FieldFormSpec`), so widgets read `field.form?.widget`, `field.form?.rows` and so on. It also
resolves `form.featureOptions` from the `featureFrom` sibling.

```ts
import type { ManifestOverrides } from '@volcanicminds/admin'
import type { GeneratedFieldMap } from './manifest.generated'

export const overrides: ManifestOverrides<GeneratedFieldMap> = {
  groups: [{ name: 'catalog', label: 'group.catalog', icon: 'layers', order: 10 }],
  resources: {
    brand: {
      group: 'catalog',
      titleField: 'name',
      fields: { name: { filterable: true }, logoUrl: { type: 'image', image: { fit: 'contain' } } },
      list: { layouts: ['table', 'card'], table: { columns: [{ field: 'name' }] }, card: { image: 'logoUrl', title: 'name' } },
      form: { columns: 2, groups: [{ name: 'main', fields: [{ field: 'name' }, { field: 'logoUrl', colSpan: 2 }] }] }
    }
  }
}
```

---

## 12. Widgets

Source: `src/ui/widgets/inputs.tsx` (`FieldInput`), `defaults.ts`, `upload/`, `richtext/`,
`tags/`, `ReferenceSelect.tsx`. Widgets are controlled components receiving `WidgetProps`:
`{ field: ResolvedField; value; onChange; disabled?; t; control? }` (`control` is the
react-hook-form control, for widgets that also drive a sibling field).

Selection order in `FieldInput`:
1. A registered `widget` component whose id is `field.form.widget`.
2. A built-in by name: `multiselect`, `combobox`, `tags`.
3. For `richtext` with no explicit widget, the registered `rich-text` editor.
4. The type default.

Registered by default (`defaultWidgets`, replaceable by registering the same id):

| Id | Widget |
|---|---|
| `image-single` | Single image upload, with alt text and preview (`ImageSingle`). |
| `gallery-reorder` | Multi-image gallery with drag reorder and cover (`GalleryReorder`). |
| `rich-text` | TipTap editor, lazy-loaded; stores HTML. |

Built-in by name:

| Id | Widget |
|---|---|
| `multiselect` | Checkbox list for an array-valued enum (`string[]`). |
| `combobox` | Free text plus a dropdown of `suggestions`; number-aware. |
| `tags` | Tag picker for a `multiple` enum: two-level menu from `EnumOption.group`, contains-typeahead, removable chips. `featureFrom` surfaces the group linked to a sibling's selected option first (reorders, never filters). `freeText` (default `verbatim`) accepts hand-typed tags on Enter or comma, trimmed and capped at 60 characters; typing an existing label stores that option's value. Value is `string[]`; declare `default: []`. |
| `password` | Password input with visibility toggle. |

Type defaults:

| Field type | Widget |
|---|---|
| `relation` | `ReferenceSelect` (sorted by the relation `titleField`; binds `foreignKey`) |
| `text`, `textarea`, `richtext` (fallback) | Textarea |
| `integer`, `number` | Plain text input with numeric `inputMode` (no spinner), parsed to a number |
| `boolean` | Switch |
| `enum` | Select |
| `date`, `datetime` | Native `date` or `datetime-local` input |
| `json` | Monospace textarea (parses JSON, else keeps the string) |
| `image`, `file` | Placeholder asking for an upload widget |
| `email`, `url`, `string`, `uuid` | Input |

Validation rules come from `required` and `validation` (required, min, max, minLength, maxLength,
pattern). Upload widgets call `image.endpoints` through the data provider's `custom()`
(multipart, files under the `files` field) and apply `image.resize` before sending.

Register a custom widget and reference it from a form entry:

```tsx
import type { WidgetProps } from '@volcanicminds/admin'

function RatingWidget({ value, onChange, disabled }: WidgetProps) {
  return <input type="range" min={0} max={5} value={value ?? 0} disabled={disabled} onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))} />
}
// <VolcanicAdmin overrides={{ widget: { rating: RatingWidget } }} ... />
// overrides: form.groups[].fields: [{ field: 'rating', widget: 'rating' }]
```

A `view` override (registered under `overrides.view`, referenced by `views.list|create|edit|show`)
receives `{ model }` (plus `id` on edit).

---

## 13. Data provider and REST mapping

`createVolcanicDataProvider` (`src/engine/providers/data.ts`) is one Refine data provider for every
resource. URL: `${apiUrl}${apiBasePath}/${resource.path}`. Every request goes through
`createApiRequest` (tenant header, bearer or cookie, JSON content type only when a body is sent,
one renewal on 401, one step-up on 403 `STEP_UP_REQUIRED`).

| Refine call | Request |
|---|---|
| `getList` | `GET <path>?<magic query>`; total from `v-total` (then `v-count`, then the page length) |
| `getList` with `pagination.mode: 'off'` | walks pages of 100 (following `v-pageSize`) until `v-total`, an empty or short page, or 500 pages |
| `getOne` | `GET <path>/<id>` (`GET <path>` for a singleton) |
| `getMany` | `GET <path>?id:in=<ids>&_pageSize=<n>` |
| `create` | `POST <path>` |
| `update` | `PUT <path>/<id>` (`PUT <path>` for a singleton) |
| `deleteOne` | `DELETE <path>/<id>` |
| `deleteMany` | `DELETE <path>` with `{ ids }` |
| `custom` | any URL; a relative URL is prefixed with `apiUrl` only (not `apiBasePath`); `FormData` sent as multipart |

Errors reach Refine as `HttpError` with `message` (translated), `code` (engine code),
`statusCode`, `errors` and `remaining` when present. `classifyBackendError` reads the backend
`code` first: `TENANT_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_NOT_FOUND`, `TENANT_MISMATCH`, `SCOPE_MISMATCH`,
`SCHEMA_BEHIND`, `TRACKING_FAILED`, `PASSWORD_TO_BE_CHANGED`, `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`,
`TENANT_DESTROYED`, the `DESTRUCTION_*` codes, and any `QUERY_*` (an invalid query, reported as
`error.invalidQuery`). Without a known code it recognizes unique, foreign-key and not-null
violations, maps 401 and 403, 404, 409, shows a clean backend message as is, and replaces raw
database text with `error.generic`.

---

## 14. Magic Query v5 bridge

Source: `src/engine/magic-query.ts` (`buildMagicQuery`, `searchFilter`, `readTotal`), aligned to
`docs/MAGIC_QUERY_V5.md` in `volcanic-backend`.

- Pagination: `_page`, `_pageSize`. Sort: `_sort=name,-createdAt` (leading `-` is descending).
- Conditions: `field:operator=value`. Lists are comma-separated; a `between` range is `from..to`;
  dates are serialized as ISO 8601.
- Empty values (undefined, null, `''`, empty array) are not sent: v5 answers 400 on them.
- Nested Refine `or`/`and` groups become aliased conditions (`field:op[c0]=value`) plus
  `_logic=(c0 OR c1) AND c2`. `_logic` is emitted only when an OR is present, and then every
  condition carries an alias.
- There is no `q` parameter: the global search is an OR over `search.fields` built by
  `searchFilter`.

Refine operator to Magic Query operator:

| Refine | MQ | Refine | MQ |
|---|---|---|---|
| `eq` | `eq` | `contains` | `containsi` |
| `ne` | `neq` | `containss` | `contains` |
| `lt`, `gt` | `lt`, `gt` | `ncontains` | `ncontainsi` |
| `lte`, `gte` | `le`, `ge` | `ncontainss` | `ncontains` |
| `in`, `nin` | `in`, `nin` | `startswith`, `startswiths` | `startsi`, `starts` |
| `between` | `between` | `endswith`, `endswiths` | `endsi`, `ends` |
| `null` | `null=true` (or `null=false` when the value is `false`) | `nnull` | `null=false` |
| `overlap` (engine) | `arrayOverlaps` | `arrayContains` (engine) | `arrayContains` |

Any other operator is dropped. `search.operator` (backend vocabulary) maps back to the matching
Refine operator; unknown or absent means case-insensitive contains.

```ts
import { buildMagicQuery, searchFilter } from '@volcanicminds/admin'

buildMagicQuery({
  pagination: { current: 2, pageSize: 25 },
  sorters: [{ field: 'name', order: 'asc' }],
  filters: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'in', value: ['active', 'draft'] }, ...searchFilter('bmw', ['name', 'model'])]
})
// shown decoded: _page=2&_pageSize=25&_sort=name&status:in[c0]=active,draft&name:containsi[c1]=bmw&model:containsi[c2]=bmw&_logic=c0 AND (c1 OR c2)
```

---

## 15. Filters, sort and search

Source: `src/ui/generators/FilterBar.tsx`, `ListView.tsx`. A field opts into filtering with
`filterable: true`. The Filters dialog AND-combines every active condition:

| Field type | Control | Operator sent |
|---|---|---|
| `enum` | multi-select chips | `in` (or `arrayOverlaps` when `multiple`) |
| `relation` | multi-select on `foreignKey` | `in` |
| `boolean` | any, yes, no | `eq` |
| `integer`, `number`, `date`, `datetime` | min and max | `ge`, `le` |

Sort: `list.sort` (or the sortable fields) drives a "sort by" select with an asc and desc toggle;
`defaultSort` seeds it. Search: `resource.search.fields` enables the global search box (section 14).

---

## 16. Actions, destruction and export

Capabilities of `kind: 'action'` render as buttons (`ActionButtons`) at their `target`: per row,
on the selection (bulk) or in the list header (collection). `visibleWhen` hides a row action
unless the record matches (operators `eq`, `neq`, `in`, `nin`, `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le`, `null`;
`{ null: false }` means "is not null"). The generic runner (`useCapabilityRunner`) calls
`custom({ url: interpolatePath(path, record), method, payload: { ...payload, ...input } })`,
asks for `input` fields in a dialog or a `confirm` first, shows a toast, invalidates the list when
`refresh`, and with `download` saves the answer as `<resource>-<name>.csv` (CSV mime) or `.txt`.

A `component` id replaces the generic button with a registered `action` component receiving
`ActionComponentProps`: `{ capability, record?, model?, run(record?, body?), t }`.

Built-in action components (`defaultActions`): `tenant-destroy` (`TenantDestroy`), wired by the
engine on the control plane to the `tenant` resource's `data` capability. Destroying a tenant
container is two tied calls: `POST /tenants/:id/destruction-request` (capability
`destruction-request`) reports the row counts and returns a one-time token, shown once with its
expiry; `DELETE /tenants/:id/data` takes `{ token, slug, otp }` (the slug typed again and the
operator's TOTP or an emailed code). The backend exports the container before destroying it. A
wrong code shows the remaining attempts; `DESTRUCTION_*` refusals have their own messages; an
already destroyed container is reported as such. The token lives only in component state.

XLS (`ListIO`, lazy `xlsx`): export downloads every record matching the current filters and sort
(walking all pages) as `.xlsx`; import is a bulk edit (rows with an `id` update, rows without
create). `image`, `file`, `json` and `writeOnly` fields are excluded both ways.

---

## 17. Access control

`createVolcanicAccessControlProvider(model)` crosses each CRUD capability's declared `roles` with
the user's roles (from `me().roles`, cached in `rolesStore`): a capability with roles needs an
overlap; one with no roles is allowed when it exists. Refine hides unauthorized buttons
(`hideIfUnauthorized`), and the sidebar shows a resource only when its landing view is reachable
(`canReachResource`). Custom actions are shown when present. This is UI filtering only; every API
route enforces its own gate.

---

## 18. Runtime behaviors

- Sticky toolbars: form and show views pin the title and action bar under the top bar.
- Saving a create or edit form redirects to the record's show view; singletons stay on their path.
- `readOnly` fields render disabled and are never submitted; image and file fields with their own
  `endpoints` are managed out of band and left out of the body. A relation inherits writability
  and `required` from its `foreignKey`, which is what gets submitted.
- Server errors keep the user on the form with a banner; an invalid submit scrolls to the first error.
- Leaving a dirty form opens the `UnsavedChangesGuard` modal.
- Clone opens the create form seeded with the record's writable values (relations as foreign
  keys, uploads skipped), then applies `cloneReset`.
- `mutationMode: 'optimistic'`: edits and deletes apply at once and roll back on error.
- Document title: `<label> · <appName>` for lists, a create prefix for create and clone, and
  `documentTitle` fields on show and edit once the record loads.
- Relative storage URLs (`/media/...`) are resolved against the API origin before rendering.

---

## 19. i18n

Source: `src/engine/i18n.tsx`. The manifest carries keys only; the project supplies
`dictionaries: Record<locale, Record<key, string>>`, merged over `defaultDictionaries` (`en` and
`it`). A missing key is humanized (its last segment, `snake_case`, `kebab-case` and `camelCase`
spaced, first letter upper-cased; for `res.<name>.singular|plural` the `<name>` segment), so a raw
key never reaches the screen. Interpolation is `{var}` (`t(key, vars)`); an unknown var stays
literal. `translate(key, vars)` works outside React.

Keys the backend emits: `res.<name>.singular|plural`, `group.<name>`. Keys the engine derives:
`field.<resource>.<field>`, `enum.<EnumName>.<value>`, `action.<resource>.<action>`.

Default key families shipped in `defaultDictionaries` (override any of them): `error.*` (unique,
reference, required, forbidden, notFound, conflict, invalidQuery, tenantRequired,
tenantNotFound, tenantDestroyed, unavailable, invalidCredentials, passwordExpired, generic),
`meta.*` (id, createdAt, updatedAt), `docTitle.*`, `action.*` (copy, clone, remove, delete,
cancel, confirm, delete.confirmTitle, delete.confirmText), `unsaved.*`, `badge.featured`,
`upload.*`, `tags.*`, `sort.*`, `filter.*`, `stepUp.*`, `login.*` (screens, stages, methods and
`login.error.*`, including `login.error.remaining`), `destroy.*`.

---

## 20. Theming, branding and icons

Theme (`AdminTheme`): tokens injected as CSS variables at `:root`; colors are HSL channels
(`"221 83% 53%"`), `radius` any CSS length; a nested `dark` object applies under `.dark`. Tokens:
`background`, `foreground`, `card`, `cardForeground`, `popover`, `popoverForeground`, `primary`,
`primaryForeground`, `secondary`, `secondaryForeground`, `muted`, `mutedForeground`, `accent`,
`accentForeground`, `destructive`, `destructiveForeground`, `border`, `input`, `ring`, `radius`.
The light, dark or system preference is stored per device (`localStorage` key
`volcanic.admin.theme`) by `ThemeProvider`, which toggles `.dark` on `<html>`.

Branding (`AdminBranding`, `src/ui/config.tsx`), all optional: `appName` (default
`'Volcanic Admin'`), `logo`, `logoDark`, `logoCollapsed`, `logoCollapsedDark`, `logoHeight` (28),
`logoMaxWidth` (170), `loginLogo` (falls back to `logo`), `loginLogoDark` (falls back to
`logoDark`), `loginLogoHeight` (56), `loginLogoMaxWidth` (260), `poweredBy` (default true; false
removes the "powered by Volcanic Minds" signature). Light and dark pairs swap with `.dark` in CSS.

Enum badge colors (`EnumOption.color`): `slate`, `gray`, `red`, `orange`, `amber`, `yellow`,
`green`, `emerald`, `teal`, `blue`, `indigo`, `violet`, `purple`, `pink`, `rose` render a soft
chip in both themes; any other value renders a neutral chip with a dot.

Rich text renders inside `.prose` with the typography variables rebound to the theme tokens, so
one `prose` class is right in both themes; do not add `dark:prose-invert`.

Icons are mapped names, not arbitrary lucide names:
- Sidebar, resource and group (`src/ui/layout/icons.tsx`): `car`, `layers`, `users`, `mail`,
  `cog`, `building`, `tag`, `boxes`, `file`, `newspaper`, `help-circle`, `inbox`, `image`, `cart`.
  Unknown names render a first-letter badge.
- Actions (`src/ui/actions/ActionButtons.tsx`): `check`, `archive`, `download`, `refresh`, `send`,
  `star`, `star-off`, `ban`, `unlock`, `key`, `trash`. Unknown names render a lightning icon.

---

## 21. Mock mode and the demo app

`npm run dev` starts the demo (`src/App.tsx`). Environment:

| Variable | Values |
|---|---|
| `VITE_ADMIN_SOURCE` | `mock` (default, in-memory) or `rest` (real backend) |
| `VITE_API_BASE_URL` | backend URL for `rest` |
| `VITE_ADMIN_PLANE` | `tenant` (default) or `control` |
| `VITE_ADMIN_TENANT` | optional fixed tenant |

Mock mode passes a static `manifest` (`mockManifest`, or `mockControlManifest` dumped from the real
backend generator), `manifestOverrides`, an in-memory `dataProvider` and an `authClient`. A
consumer reproduces it by passing `manifest`, `dataProvider` and `authClient`. Mock accounts: any
non-empty password logs in; `mfa@acme.example` asks for TOTP `123456`; `setup@acme.example` asks for a
forced TOTP enrolment; an email code is `12345678`; on the account page a current password of
`wrong` makes the password change fail.

---

## 22. Typed field names and the pull CLI

```bash
volcanic-admin-pull --url http://localhost:2230 [--token <bearer>] [--plane tenant|control] [--out ./src]
volcanic-admin-pull --from ./manifest.json [--out ./src]
```

It validates the manifest against `manifest.v2.schema.json` (Ajv), then writes:

- `<out>/manifest.generated.ts`: always overwritten. Exports `generatedManifest` and
  `type GeneratedFieldMap = { resourceName: 'field1' | 'field2' }` (`never` for a resource with no fields).
- `<out>/manifest.overrides.ts`: scaffolded once if absent, then yours:
  `export const overrides: ManifestOverrides<GeneratedFieldMap> = {}`.

Typing overrides against `GeneratedFieldMap` gives per-resource field-name autocomplete and typo
checking on every field reference. It is a `type` alias, not an `interface`, so it satisfies the
`FieldMap` index-signature constraint. `--plane control` pulls `/system/manifest`. In cookie mode
the backend accepts only integration tokens in the header and the control plane has none: pull
that one from a `MANIFEST_DUMP_PLANE=control` dump with `--from`.

---

## 23. Public API index

From `@volcanicminds/admin`:

- Root: `VolcanicAdmin`, `defineAdminPlugin`; types `VolcanicAdminProps`, `AdminCustomRoute`,
  `AdminOverrides`, `AdminPlugin`, `AdminTheme`, `AdminThemeTokens`.
- Manifest and model: all types of `types/manifest.ts` and `types/model.ts`; `interpretManifest`,
  `toRefineResources`, `mergeManifest`, `deepMerge`, types `ManifestOverrides`, `ResourceOverride`,
  `FieldOverride`, `CapabilityOverride`, `FieldMap`; `ManifestProvider`, `useModel`,
  `useResourceModel`, types `ManifestSource`, `ManifestProviderProps`.
- Query: `buildMagicQuery`, `searchFilter`, `readTotal`; actions `interpolatePath`,
  `matchVisibleWhen`, `actionsByTarget`.
- Providers: `createVolcanicDataProvider` (`VolcanicDataProviderOptions`, `AuthMode`),
  `createApiRequest` (`ApiRequest`, `ApiRequestOptions`), `createVolcanicAuthProvider`
  (`VolcanicAuthOptions`), `createVolcanicAccessControlProvider`, `rolesStore`,
  `canAccessResource`, `canReachResource`, `classifyBackendError` (`ClassifiedError`).
- Auth: `createVolcanicAuthClient`, `FLOW_ENDING_CODES`, `PLANE_ENDPOINTS`, `MANIFEST_PATH`,
  `tokenStore`, `createStepUpBroker`, `adoptStepUp`, `AuthClientProvider`, `useAuthClient`; types
  `AuthClient`, `AuthData`, `FlowAnswer`, `FlowChallenge`, `FlowOption`, `FlowOptions`,
  `FlowPending`, `MfaSetup`, `VolcanicAuthClientOptions`, `Plane`, `StepUpBroker`, `StepUpHandler`.
- Tenancy: `TenantProvider`, `useTenant`, `tenantStore`, `primeTenantStore`, `storedTenant`,
  type `TenantOption`.
- Registry and i18n: `createOverrideRegistry`, `RegistryProvider`, `useRegistry`
  (`OverrideRegistry`, `OverrideKind`); `I18nProvider`, `useI18n`, `useT`, `translate`,
  `defaultDictionaries` (`Dictionary`, `Dictionaries`).
- UI: `AdminLayout`, `Sidebar`, `TenantSwitcher`, `LoginView`, `ForgotPasswordView`,
  `ResetPasswordView`, `AccountView`, `resourceRouteElements`, `ListView`, `ListTable`,
  `ListCards`, `ListIO`, `ShowView`, `AutoForm`, `SingletonView`, `FieldInput`, `formFieldName`,
  `FieldCell`, `FieldValue`, `ReferenceSelect`, `ImageSingle`, `GalleryReorder`,
  `RichTextWidget`, `TagsWidget`, `TagsMenu`, `defaultWidgets`, `defaultActions`, `TenantDestroy`,
  `ConfirmDialog`, `StepUpDialog`, `UnsavedChangesGuard`, `ImagePreviewDialog`,
  `notificationProvider`, `Toaster`, `AdminConfigProvider`, `useAdminConfig`, `ThemeProvider`,
  `useTheme`; types `WidgetProps`, `ActionComponentProps`, `OptionGroup`, `Taxonomy`,
  `TagSuggestion`, `ConfirmDialogProps`, `ImagePreviewDialogProps`, `AdminNavItem`,
  `AdminBranding`, `ThemeMode`.

## 24. Gotchas

- Import `@volcanicminds/admin/styles.css` once: the built JavaScript does not import it.
- Rich text stores HTML from a constrained schema (no `<script>`). Against an untrusted backend
  still sanitize server-side; offer only toolbar actions the server sanitizer keeps.
- Do not create a second React Query client inside overrides: Refine v4 owns its QueryClient.
  Invalidate through Refine (`useInvalidate`).
- Capability and upload paths go through `custom()`, which prefixes `apiUrl` but not `apiBasePath`.
- A pinned `manifest` of the other plane is refused at render; set `plane` to match.
- On the tenant plane of a multi-tenant backend the manifest itself needs the tenant header:
  without one the backend answers `TENANT_REQUIRED` and the console asks for an organization.
- Engine development loop: after rebuilding `dist`, a consuming app clears Vite's cache
  (`rm -rf node_modules/.vite`) to pick it up.
